tests.desc: Non-JSON or malformed proposal is strictly intercepted by fail_closed parser
Proposal attempting to bind undeclared terminal is rejected (strict) and degraded to CLARIFY (fail-closed)
Proposal attempting to overwrite deterministic context terminal is caught
Model hallucination of ungrounded entity (quibble) intercepted by admissibility validation
Forged or uncertified model proposals cannot commit state or write to EvidenceLedger

summary.authority_principle: Model proposal generation and deterministic commit authority are strictly isolated.
